artifact_hash_policy: sha256 of exact file bytes, with no newline normalization

README.md.provenance: Human-readable scope and reproduction instructions for this qualification.

pytest.log.provenance: Original final qualification stdout/stderr log, copied byte-for-byte.

revalidation.json.provenance: Postqualification import, source, preparation and scoped Ruff receipt; historical checks are explicitly distinguished.

sources-after.json.provenance: Manifest recaptured during the timestamped postqualification read-only revalidation.

sources-before.json.provenance: Original 61-file manifest saved immediately before the final test run, copied byte-for-byte.

claim_scope: No live cost, quality, availability, or comparative performance result.
coverage: Strict integer allowances, stage sums, exact per-trial cap projection and caller-detached freeze state.
Source/dependency/policy/directory binding before provider or workflow database admission.
Twelve scheduled pilot arms, fixed three-stage topology, bounded generated graphs and dynamic parallel overlap.
All planning and execution requests accounted in durable native-response evidence.
Failed/completed outcome retention, unknown billing admission refusal and same-run crash recovery without rebuy.
Independent campaign writer lock, reparse/linked ancestry and SQLite/receipt path rejection.
Retained accounting, output, checkpoints, native raw bodies, decoded data, all non-lease events and unaccepted quote evidence reconciliation.
Historical preparation immutability, ignored scratch exclusion, and permanently closed main/judge commands.

offline_fixture.client_boundary: OpenAIResponsesProvider._get_client replaced by SimpleNamespace clients and AsyncMock methods.
offline_fixture.dependency_binding: Test fixture labels; offline-contract-sdk, offline-contract-python, offline-contract-yaml.

postqualification_revalidation.scope: Fresh read-only import proof, scoped Ruff, 61-file manifest equality, preparation equality and main explicit-file equality.

test_run.duration_scope: Offline test-suite wall time; not pilot workflow latency or a performance benchmark.
test_run.exit_code_provenance: Final qualification process result observed by the agent; raw log contains the pytest summary.
test_run.import_root: same frozen repository root, set explicitly through PYTHONPATH
test_run.network: No live provider calls; in-process fake Responses client.

exclusions: Subsequent distribution metadata/build-hook and version changes
tested_source.source_inventory: git ls-files -z -- smythe/*.py plus benchmarks/astra_runtime.py, tests/test_astra_runtime.py, and pyproject.toml
